newsitem.title: USA: ENCAD expects Q1 EPS $0.31 vs $0.18.
newsitem.headline: ENCAD expects Q1 EPS $0.31 vs $0.18.

text.p: ENCAD Inc said Monday it expects to report a 72 percent rise in first quarter earnings, to $0.31 a share from $0.l8 a year earlier. The First Call estimate is $0.29.
ENCAD said it expects revenues of $31.5 million, compared to $19.6 million a year ago.
The improved results are due to strength across the company's product line, a growing supplies business, and growth from its OEM business, ENCAD said.
ENCAD makes products based on digital-imaging technology, including color inkjet digital imaging platforms, software utilities and scientifically-matched inks and media.
